soil_types.name: Sandy Soil
soil_types.characteristics: Fast-draining, warms up quickly in spring, poor water and nutrient retention
soil_types.improvement: Add organic matter (compost, well-rotted manure) to improve water retention and fertility

soil_types.name: Loamy Soil
soil_types.nutrients: naturally fertile with good mineral balance
soil_types.characteristics: Ideal garden soil — crumbly texture, holds moisture without waterlogging
soil_types.improvement: Maintain with annual compost mulch to sustain fertility

soil_types.name: Clay Soil
soil_types.nutrients: high mineral content; can bind nutrients
soil_types.characteristics: Heavy and sticky when wet, hard when dry; prone to waterlogging
soil_types.improvement: Incorporate grit/sand and organic matter; raised beds recommended for most flowers

soil_types.name: Silty Soil
soil_types.nutrients: good nutrient content; holds moisture well
soil_types.characteristics: Smooth silky texture when wet; can compact easily; generally fertile
soil_types.improvement: Add organic matter to prevent compaction; avoid heavy foot traffic

soil_types.name: Peaty Soil
soil_types.nutrients: low in major nutrients; high organic matter
soil_types.characteristics: Dark, spongy, acidic; retains enormous amounts of water
soil_types.improvement: Lime to raise pH for most plants; add grit to improve drainage

soil_types.name: Chalky / Alkaline Soil
soil_types.nutrients: calcium-rich; phosphorus and iron may be unavailable at high pH
soil_types.characteristics: Contains calcium carbonate chunks; raises soil pH; free-draining
soil_types.improvement: Add sulphur to lower pH; incorporate compost; choose lime-tolerant plants

soil_types.name: Orchid Bark Mix
soil_types.characteristics: Chunky bark pieces allow air to roots; mimics epiphytic growing conditions
soil_types.improvement: Replace when bark starts to decompose (typically every 2 years)

soil_types.name: Laterite / Tropical Red Soil
soil_types.nutrients: iron and aluminium rich; low nitrogen and phosphorus
soil_types.characteristics: Reddish-brown, granular, found in tropical regions; very porous
soil_types.improvement: Heavy organic matter amendment essential; regular fertilisation required
